mentions.title: What is Brain Rot? Have you ever felt like your brain is tired but you can’t stop scrolling? That’s not just you—it’s something called brain rot. Brain rot happens when we spend too much time consuming endless content, like videos, news, and posts, without even realizing it’s draining us. But what if this wasn’t an accident? In this video, we’ll show you how brain rot quietly traps your focus, leaving you feeling stuck and distracted. You’ll see why so many people fall into this endless loop and how to recognize the signs in your own life. But there’s hope. You can fight back. Imagine clearing away the fog and taking back control of your thoughts and time. Want to know how? Watch till the end to see the first step. Don’t keep this to yourself—share it with someone who needs clarity. And come back tomorrow to discover how to break free from the brain rot trap for good!  #brainrot #SelfCare #MentalHealth #socialmedia #life #mentalhealthmatters #selfhelp #mentalhealthsupport
